records.rationale: Keyboard input is repeated across command guidance and benefits from one semantic, tokenized primitive.

evidence.accessibility: Uses the native kbd element and keeps key names as readable text.
evidence.performance: One inline element and token-only CSS.
evidence.ownership: Represents user input, not shortcut detection.
evidence.migration: Existing raw kbd markup can switch directly.

records.rationale: Locale, relative-time refresh, timezone, hydration, and machine-readable formatting need a dedicated contract.

evidence.accessibility: Visible relative text and an absolute accessible label need user testing.
evidence.state: Periodic relative-time refresh ownership is unresolved.
evidence.ssr: Server timezone and hydration drift require an approved deterministic policy.
evidence.performance: Shared scheduling is needed before many timestamps can update efficiently.
evidence.ownership: Deferred until I18nProvider and application timezone responsibilities are explicit.
evidence.migration: Applications retain native time elements and their existing formatters.

records.rationale: Native blockquote plus Text already covers the semantics; repeated design-system demand is not yet demonstrated.

evidence.accessibility: Native semantics are sufficient when attribution is authored correctly.
evidence.performance: No design-system abstraction is needed for performance.
evidence.ownership: Consumers retain content and attribution semantics.

records.rationale: Citation numbering, source identity, links, popovers, SSR, and unsafe URL policy require product evidence and security review.

evidence.accessibility: Reference relationships and repeated link names need a defined pattern.
evidence.state: Popover and source-list ownership are unresolved.
evidence.security: External URL and untrusted source metadata policy must precede a component.
evidence.ssr: Stable citation numbering needs a deterministic document-level model.
evidence.performance: Large source lists may require shared indexing.
evidence.ownership: Deferred until an ordinary citation data contract is evidenced.

records.rationale: A plain-text, overflow-safe code surface is broadly useful while explicitly excluding highlighting and raw HTML.

evidence.accessibility: Uses pre/code semantics, preserves text, and allows an accessible label.
evidence.security: Accepts text children only; no raw HTML, Markdown, or syntax-highlighting execution.
evidence.performance: No parser or highlighter is bundled.
evidence.ownership: Presentation only; language tooling and execution are excluded.

records.rationale: KeyValuePairs already provides the same structured metadata-list role, so a second primitive would duplicate API and guidance.

evidence.accessibility: The existing component already supplies description-list semantics.
